meta.title: Beaver Savings — Save bit by bit
meta.description: Plan your monthly savings based on your salary, taxes, and expenses. A savings calculator built for Portugal.

hero.title: Save the way a beaver bites wood
hero.subtitle: Bit by bit.
hero.description: Plan your monthly savings based on your salary, taxes, and expenses. Build habits that stick — one small deposit at a time.

features.title: Everything you need to plan smarter
features.description: From quick monthly estimates to full-year projections — built for how people actually earn and spend in Portugal.

items.title: Monthly calculator
items.description: Estimate net income, expenses, and how much you can save each month with realistic Portuguese tax and social security inputs.

items.title: Annual savings plan
items.description: Project your accumulated savings across 12 months and see how small, consistent deposits add up over time.

items.title: Export & share
items.description: Download a PDF summary or email your results so you can keep a record or share with someone you trust.

steps.title: Three steps to your savings plan
steps.description: No spreadsheets required. Just your numbers and a few minutes.

items.title: Enter your income
items.description: Base salary, subsidies, extras, and tax rates — or upload a payslip.

items.title: Set your savings goal
items.description: Choose a percentage of net income or a fixed monthly amount.

items.title: Track your progress
items.description: Review monthly results, export reports, and build your annual plan.

cta.title: Ready to build your dam of savings?
cta.description: Start with this month. Small, steady contributions beat big promises every time.
